paragraphs.text: Lighthouse Island , or the Isle of Stonehaven , is an island off the coast of Stonehaven , the western part of Corondor on the plane of Dominaria .

Lighthouse Island is an elongated mountainous island , protecting the western coast of Corondor . The lighthouses once guided vessels from the Western Sea to the formerly proud ports of Arathoxia . Once, that city was a glimmer of hope, welcoming all to the beauty that is Corondor. Now she lies mostly abandoned and in ruin. The once friendly merfolk have become suspicious of strangers, and spirits both fair and foul are rumored to haunt this place.

After the Fall of Arathoxia in 4195 AR, Ravidel sent warships out and took control of the islands of Stonehaven , including Lighthouse Island, to lock out any interference from the Domains in the west.
